sleep.title: Hotel 10 km from the airport
sleep.text: Hilton Garden Inn Shenzhen Airport is in the Fuyong area, about 10 km from the airport, at Cuigang West Road 9. Guests have free Wi-Fi and parking, a fitness centre and a restaurant on the top floor. Check-in starts at 15:00 and check-out is by 12:00; phone: +86 755 29993999.
